headlines.text: Looking back to 2026, when Darby Allin vs. Brody King fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.48 ? a hard-hitting, high-quality battle. Allin escaped a barrage of Brody King offense ? including a powerbomb on the exposed floor ? countering with a drop toe hold into a steel chair before finishing with the Coffin Drop for his second successful defense.
On a Wednesday in 2020, back when Lance Archer vs. Dustin Rhodes met in a Tournament Match, closing out the card as the main event on Dynamite, rated 6.83.

Back on this day in 2022, Samoa Joe vs. Trent Beretta fought tooth and nail for the ROH World TV Title, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.51. For Trent Beretta, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Championship gold always raises the stakes.
